## Overview

This page summarizes the initial HMM search results using seed models built from curated 2A peptide alignments.

## Seed Alignments

The seed alignments contain known, experimentally validated 2A peptides:

| Class | Peptides | Source |
|-------|----------|--------|
| Class 1 | T2A, E2A, P2A | Picornaviruses |
| Class 2 | F2A variants | Aphthoviruses |

## Search Statistics

```{python}
#| label: search-stats
#| eval: false

import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

# Load search statistics (when available)
results_dir = Path("../../scratch/results")

# Example statistics table
stats = pd.DataFrame({
    'Database': ['UniProt', 'RefProt', 'UniParc', 'MGnify'],
    'Class 1 Hits': [45, 128, 892, 3421],
    'Class 2 Hits': [23, 67, 445, 1893],
    'E-value < 1e-10': [68, 195, 1337, 5314]
})

stats
```

### By E-value

```{python}
#| label: evalue-dist
#| eval: false

import plotnine as p9
import numpy as np

# Example E-value distribution
evalues = np.random.exponential(1e-8, 1000)
df = pd.DataFrame({'evalue': evalues})

(p9.ggplot(df, p9.aes(x='evalue'))
 + p9.geom_histogram(bins=50)
 + p9.scale_x_log10()
 + p9.labs(x='E-value', y='Count', title='E-value Distribution')
 + p9.theme_minimal())
```

## Quality Metrics

### Alignment Length Distribution

Expected alignment lengths:
- Class 1: 18-22 residues
- Class 2: 20-24 residues

### Conservation Scores

Key conserved positions in seed alignments:
- Position -1 (G): >95% conserved
- Position 0 (P): 100% conserved
- Position -4 (N/P): >90% conserved
